transactioncolumncustomfield.description: SOURCED from the item, not written by script: Source List = Item, Source From = TrackTrace Eligibility. It puts the item's own eligibility on the line the moment the item is chosen, so a user, a saved search and the reconciliation page can all tell a sync-required line from a non-sync-required one without running anything. The script reads it before falling back to a search - but ONLY when the Eligibility Field ID on the configuration is still the shipped custitem_jj_rb_eligible, because sourcing is fixed in this object and cannot follow a client's own field.
